blocks.title: Line
blocks.instr: Watch, then listen. What's in the cloud? Write it in the Zoom chat.
blocks.instr2: What was hard to hear? Why?

lines.after: but if I could, what do you want me to see?

lines.text: I love that five. {{Can we make it}} more graphic?
lines.before: Try making the photo grid bigger.

lines.text: If you requested to transfer, {{we can make}} that happen.
{{Can't leave}} before the Boss leaves, Davis.
{{how long can a woman}} be mad at you for?

lines.before: I should probably actually just talk to her, huh? Obviously.

lines.text: No, no, {{I-I can set}} it up.
{{Can you take it}} to the photo studio? {{There's lots of}} cleaners and stuff in there.
lines.before: Yes, Jules spilled soy sauce on her Saint Laurent jacket.

lines.text: Jules, {{we can't keep up}} with our own success.
lines.before: We hit our five-year goal in nine months. Exactly.
run every idea I have by this person?
You were in there a long time.

lines.text: Why don't you tell her {{you can't drive her today}},
lines.before: … from a paper bag. I don't know what you're talking about, man.

lines.text: {{Well, I can't change}} the facts, dear.
lines.before: You know I haven't slept in two years.
